stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 ETSI TS 138 212 V19.2.0: NR multiplexing and channel coding，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：有效碼率應用資訊位元除以實際傳送編碼位元；CRC、填充與率匹配需分別記帳，不能把所有校驗當有效資料。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：合成資訊1000 bit、CRC24 bit；第一傳送2048 coded bit，第二1536；不聲稱實作某NR基圖。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read ETSI TS 138 212 V19.2.0: NR multiplexing and channel coding to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: Effective code rate uses information bits divided by transmitted coded bits; CRC, filler and rate matching require separate accounting. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Use1000 information bits plus24 CRC bits and transmit2048 then1536 coded bits; this is not an implementation of an NR base graph. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
